title: Proxy Trap Interception & Reflect Forwarding
description: Trace [[Get]] interception, Receiver forwarding, and invariant enforcement.

steps.label: 1. Exotic [[Get]] Dispatch
steps.description: Engine bypasses standard Inline Cache lookup because receiver is a Proxy exotic object.

steps.label: 2. Reflect.get With Receiver
steps.description: Trap delegates to Reflect.get(target, prop, receiver) so getters on target bind 'this' to proxy.

steps.label: 3. Invariant Enforcement
steps.description: Engine verifies trap return value obeys non-writable, non-configurable property invariants before returning.
